text: Your head is full, but your to-do list is empty.
Record a quick voice note: email the client, buy groceries, book the dentist next week.
In an AI tool that supports voice input, say: turn this into a checklist.
Keep every task, use only deadlines I mentioned, and flag anything unclear.
Now you have a list you can use. Check it against your note.
The AI organised your tasks; it hasn't done them.
